purpose: Photographed-looking base pictures for what Mack carries in place of the phone (story/phone.md): the pager (ポケベル), the ring-bound notebook and the things tucked into it. Each is one object seen straight down on a plain ground, to be cut out and used as a surface the game draws on: every display, page, card and label is BLANK, because digits, handwriting and print are composited in the engine. Design reference: the mock-up at https://claude.ai/artifact/HmLoAUjpEfS679J4BH87pJ. Nothing here goes into the game without the user's approval.

items.style: top-down flat lay photograph, shot on 35mm film, soft directional light from the upper left, fine film grain, muted colours, true to life wear and patina, sharp focus
items.subject: a single early 1990s Japanese numeric pager, a small black matte plastic rectangular device the size of a matchbox with slightly rounded corners, one narrow single-line grey-green LCD window that is switched off and completely blank, two small dark rubber buttons below the window, one tiny red indicator lamp, scuffed corners worn pale and fine scratches from years in a coat pocket, a little dust in the seams, lying flat and seen straight down from directly above
items.composition: the object centred and whole in the frame with a wide margin all round, long side horizontal, isolated on a plain matte mid-grey seamless background with a soft shadow, nothing else in the picture
items.notes: The LCD must be blank: the digits are drawn by the game. Any lettering on the case will be painted out.
